interpretation: Fresh-seed confirmation of a frozen six-method K=8192 comparison after exploratory CV2 half-step diagnostics; no K_needed claim.
contrast_interval: 95% paired bootstrap over eight new method seeds, conditional on the fixed HMC pool
primary_interpretation_rule: Report signed paired W2 differences and 95% intervals. Claim a W2 advantage only when its interval excludes zero; report pooled guarded mean and covariance gates separately. Do not claim an equal-cost advantage from fixed K.
cost_rule: Report setup-inclusive ensemble seconds and actual operation counts; include anchor, CV full gradient, CV2 Hessian, and p-method metric pilot. HMC reference generation and scoring are external evaluation costs.
mixing_rule: Existing four-chain diagnostics are exploratory supporting evidence and cannot be inferred from replica K; no K_needed certificate from this experiment.
timing: sequential runs with one BLAS thread; setup-inclusive ensemble seconds
